summary: The R1.3 governance owner-transfer fixture is substantively strong: its removal list matches the actual cold-only surface 1:1, the preservation bullets pin the real ordinary seams (#2273 binding in collect_working_set/_recommendations, #2277/#1769 maintenance collector/evaluator/oracle, filesystems.cold=/data/GHDC label), the mixed-test classification bullet cleanly partitions all three suites, the real-engine bullet correctly defers to the pre-existing integration harness, and the verification floor matches project-profile.md's working-set row. Two axes fall below the bar this change's own PGDATA slice set (round-1 review A2/A4): the new collector owner's required PathTestRule contents are not enumerated, and the one concrete current-doc line-pin that goes stale is not named. Both additions are slice-scoped; no epic renegotiation, no R1.4/R2/R3 demand.

required_additions.axis: Selector closure contents for the new resource-governance collection owner
required_additions.evidence: For a producer module the explicit PathTestRule tuple is the entire PR-time selection: the #1561 importer closure builds lazily only for changed test suites (scripts/select_ci_tests.py:4654-4663), and PR backend runs only selector-targeted tests, degrading to --collect-only (zero assertions) when unrouted (AGENTS.md:96). The current rule for packages/common/node27_cold_governance_collection.py selects only test_node27_cold_governance.py/test_node27_resource_governance.py/test_node27_working_set.py (scripts/select_ci_tests.py:4484-4491) and already omits tests/test_node27_maintenance_output_integration.py, which directly imports collect_postgres (:20) and governance._maintenance_output_recommendations/AuditThresholds (:21, :145-149). observation_int is shared by collect_working_set (packages/common/node27_cold_governance_collection.py:140) and cold_governance_sample (:646-679), so the fixture's own rules (no cold dependency in the new owner; remaining cold callers import the real owner directly; no copied helpers per design.md) force it into the new owner with a qualified back-import from the retained cold module — making tests/test_node27_cold_governance.py (which receives the moved cold_governance_sample tests) a still-live cold consumer suite of the new module. The fixture says only 'selector points to existing assertions' (Consumers row), below the explicit-enumeration bar set by fixtures/retirement-pgdata-owner-transfer.md and its round-1 review addition A2.
required_additions.addition: State the required rule contents: the new packages/common/node27_resource_governance_collection.py PathTestRule selects tests/test_node27_resource_governance.py, tests/test_node27_working_set.py, tests/test_node27_maintenance_output_integration.py (direct importers) and tests/test_node27_cold_governance.py (still-live cold consumer via the retained cold module's back-import of moved helpers); the scripts/node27_resource_governance.py rule adds tests/test_node27_maintenance_output_integration.py (imports CLI internals); the tests/test_select_ci_tests.py expected-map update lands in the same merge; the old rule's omission of the integration suite must not be replicated onto the new owner. Narrowing the retained cold module/schema/example rules and dropping the cold suite from the CLI rule remain R3.5's end-state job, not this slice's.

required_additions.evidence: docs/runbooks/tier-node27-timeseries-storage.md:7561 cites `node27_cold_governance_collection.py:246` as a live pg_stat_activity reader in the §9.2 measured-privilege audit — a current ops section supporting the no-GRANT-pg_read_all_stats conclusion, not a withdrawn G0-G8 section. After this slice, collect_postgres (holding the connections_by_state pg_stat_activity query, packages/common/node27_cold_governance_collection.py:447-460) moves to the new owner, so the module attribution goes stale (the :246 line number is already historical drift). The fixture's 'Repoint current runbook source references' is generic; the PGDATA slice's round-1 review (A4) required an unambiguous docs boundary. Verified no other current doc line-pins moved symbols: docs/runbooks/current-production-ops.md (:2360-2367) and docs/runbooks/node-27-database-container-operations.md (:212-215) reference only the stable CLI path, docs/adr/0002-node27-timeseries-hot-cold-tiering.md (:282-285, :356-358) references the CLI/DEFAULT_SERVICES, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md name no governance module, and archived-change docs plus the timeseries-narrow-store-expand-contract change records are delivery history, not current guidance.
required_additions.addition: One line of explicit disposition: repoint docs/runbooks/tier-node27-timeseries-storage.md:7561 to the new owner module's collect_postgres pg_stat_activity read in this slice (its 'lane with no converted template' characterization is unchanged); state that no other current runbook citation of the moved symbols exists, so reviewers do not disagree on the docs boundary.

verified_pass: Removal census exact: CLI cold surface is imports (scripts/node27_resource_governance.py:22-45), 16 cold AuditConfig fields (:94-110), four local cold args + add_cold_governance_arguments (:727-749), validate_cold_governance_arguments in config_from_args (:795), _cold_runtime_config (:187-201) and the build_receipt cold branch emitting cold_tablespace_governance (:648-676) — the fixture's removal list matches 1:1, and `--cold-governance-*` flags have no non-test caller (grep: only the CLI, packages/common/node27_cold_governance_cli.py:54-122, and tests/test_node27_resource_governance.py:435-484 / tests/test_node27_working_set.py:303-307,416-418).

Cold-only catalog inventory claim verified: external_pg_tblspc_targets (:511-517), cold_tablespace (:518-526) and cold_relation_by_tablespace (:528-539) are consumed solely by packages/common/node27_cold_governance_runtime.py (:43-47, :121-125) and _cold_relation_bytes (:610-623) — all cold-owned; no ordinary recommendation or runbook reads them, and no test pins the cold_tablespace_governance output key.

filesystems.cold label characterization accurate: collect_filesystem (:353-360) observes /data/GHDC under the 'cold' key as plain disk telemetry; the fixture retains it as an observation label, and ordinary keys (pgdata_root_fs/pg_wal du, repo/object-store targets, home) move whole with collect_filesystem.

#2273 ordinary binding lives entirely outside the cold branch: collect_working_set binding/blockers/null-free (:134-173) plus _recommendations capacity gates WORKING_SET_FILESYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE / PGDATA_USAGE_UNAVAILABLE / PROJECTED_PEAK_EXCEEDS_WORKING_SET_FREE (scripts/node27_resource_governance.py:213-282) plus working-set suite oracles (test_cli_destination_capacity_not_home, test_cli_missing_capacity_and_usage_fail_independently, test_cli_configured_paths_and_duplicate_device_labels, test_current_comparator_never_falls_back_to_historical_home) — fixture's preserve bullets and matrix Validators row are executable as written.

#2277/#1769 maintenance surface correctly delimited as ordinary: collector collect_maintenance_output + effective-threshold CTE/50-row bound (packages/common/node27_cold_governance_collection.py:40-120) and evaluator _maintenance_output_recommendations (scripts/node27_resource_governance.py:487-557); the real-engine oracle tests/test_node27_maintenance_output_integration.py exercises reloptions override, autovacuum_enabled=false exclusion, zero-statistics class, row bound and summary shape; fixture correctly keeps its pre-existing harness (pytest.mark.integration; NHMS_RUN_INTEGRATION=1 + NHMS_INTEGRATION_DATABASE_URL with per-test throwaway_database_url, tests/conftest.py:182-229) and forbids a production DB.

Mixed-test classification bullet is complete against the live suites: cold-only sample/receipt tests to move to the cold owner (tests/test_node27_resource_governance.py:150-360 cold_governance_sample/reconcile_filesystems tests, :368-419 unavailable-home build_cold_governance_receipt test) match the retained cold modules; CLI cold-arg tests to remove (:434-490 and tests/test_node27_working_set.py:302-311) demand exactly the removed integration; the mixed both-sinks redaction test (tests/test_node27_working_set.py:406-427) keeps its ordinary summary/stderr legs under 'do not remove protective ordinary behavior'; remaining ordinary tests import only the CLI and moved collection functions.

No public caller break: infra/systemd/nhms-node27-resource-governance.{service,timer} and scripts/node27_resource_governance_once.sh contain no cold references; no runbook or script invokes --cold-governance-*; deployed unit ExecStart is the wrapper with NODE27_RESOURCE_GOVERNANCE_* env (docs/runbooks/receipts/2026-09-13-issue-2162-unpin-node27-runtime units-after.txt:40-44), and the fixture's no-live-unit-mutation / issue1987-pin / readonly-smoke constraints match that deployed reality.

R3.7 row-1 pull-in consistent: the env example's cold block (infra/env/node27-resource-governance.example:28-55, all NODE27_COLD_GOVERNANCE_* lines, verified no other docs/infra cold-governance declarations) is removed 'with the Python CLI/config branch' exactly as tasks.md R3.7 requires, while the #2273 PGDATA binding comments, DATABASE_URL and compression-lag lines survive; the fixture's argparse-refusal smoke covers the closure proof's surviving-config smoke.

R4.1 matching delta correct: specs/node27-pgdata-relocation/spec.md MODIFIED placement requirement carries the governance binding sentence ('Ordinary governance MUST preserve actual PGDATA device/available-space binding and refuse unknown or conflicting placement without ... importing retired cold modules'); the retained SQL-performance ADDED requirement correctly waits for R1.4; the ci-contract-baseline delta's 'extracted sampling behavior's surviving suites ... never deleted tests/test_node27_cold_governance.py' anticipates this slice's end state without requiring cold-suite deletion now.

Targeted suite list justified: tests/test_node27_pgdata_migrate.py pins the governance unit/env binding (test_governance_target_exception_does_not_unbind_other_caller_configuration :675-705 on NODE27_GOVERNANCE_PGDATA_ROOT; test_primary_environment_allows_bound_governance_release :984-997) — a real cross-suite edge of the CLI env contract the slice must not shift; tests/test_select_ci_tests.py covers the expected maps.

Risk packs match project-profile.md for this surface: CLI entry/critical exit, env config, statvfs/du path, redaction, bounded SQL/subprocess, partial-output, packaging/selector and docs packs selected; domain PostGIS/TimescaleDB (maintenance/working-set SQL) and published-evidence identity (PGDATA device binding) selected; geospatial/SHUD/Slurm/provider/manifest correctly unselected — no such surface exists in the slice.

Size-guard line present and satisfiable: every touched file shrinks or stays under the 1000-line ratchet (CLI 910→~700, collection 702→cold remnant ~150 + new module ~550, resource suite 1251→~950 by moving cold tests out, cold suite 371→~650), so .large-file-guard.json needs no new exemption (maxLines 1000, zero governance entries today).
verification_gaps: Read-only fixture review per subagent boundary: no tests, selector runs, openspec validation or linting executed; all caller/consumer/selector claims rest on direct inspection of the cited lines. Whether the prescribed suites pass pre-change and the batched red proof actually discriminates the old cold CLI/output path at pre-change source is the implementer's node-27 evidence duty, not settled here.
residual_risks: The exact 'required sampling helpers' split (safe_resolve, filesystem_identity, observation_int, compression_lag_seconds, collect_maintenance_output and the SQL constants) is implementer freedom; cross-review must reject copied helpers, cold re-exports, or a new-owner dependency on cold, and require the cold module's back-import to be a qualified module reference.

The ordinary audit receipt has no JSON schema file; wire stability (ordinary keys preserved, cold keys absent) is pinned only by tests — the changed-behavior tests must discriminate both the argparse refusal and the receipt key absence at pre-change source, not only one of them.

The sibling active change timeseries-narrow-store-expand-contract (proposal/tasks/fixtures/receipts) and archived change docs reference node27_cold_governance_collection.py as delivery records of merged #1985/#2273/#2277 work; they are history, not current guidance — no repoint in this slice, but R4.2/archive disposition must not treat them as authority.
